answer: No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 64 identities per epoch. Audits are recorded in terrace, queued in vault, and garden publishes the wait time. A farm of 316 fresh keys thus waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 4514 identities would post 4899 proofs and burn roughly 3 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
